assets.alt_text: Multiple beehives carried in a purpose-built rack on a stationary bee-transport truck
assets.caption: Colonies prepared for transport. The vehicle shows multiple hives held in an organised rack system; actual transport still requires verified restraint, roof/floor security, entrance management, ventilation, load limits and legal compliance.
assets.credit: Public-domain photograph by Marion Schneider & Christoph Aistleitner.
